import os,json
P='/home/ubuntu/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-turns/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs'

code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    c = Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    bg = c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [r[:] for r in grid]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(1, w - 1):
            if grid[i][j] == bg and grid[i][j-1] != bg and grid[i][j+1] != bg:
                out[i][j] = 2
    return out
'''
